name: house_night
prompt: Exterior of a small single-story suburban house painted faded pale pastel pink on a foggy rainy night, overgrown dark lawn, blank yellow police tape fluttering, wet empty street, distant soft red and blue emergency lights glowing far away, lonely and ominous. No street signs, no house numbers, no people.

name: wheelchair_gypsy
prompt: Interior of a dim bedroom. A slender young woman in her early twenties seen from behind in three-quarter back view, sitting in an oversized wheelchair, wearing a loose knitted beanie and a plain oversized dress. Her face is completely turned away and hidden in deep shadow, no facial features visible. Cold blue rim light, a towering dark shadow of an adult cast on the wall behind her, tragic and claustrophobic, no gore.

name: phone_dark
prompt: A dark wooden desk at night, a smartphone lying face up glowing dimly with a blank screen, scattered papers, cold blue light, nobody present.

name: bedroom_door
prompt: A dark narrow hallway inside a small house at night, a bedroom door slightly ajar, a cold flashlight beam on the wooden floor, dust in the air, nobody present, no gore.

name: empty_room
prompt: An empty young woman's bedroom at night, a neatly made bed, closed curtains, a few stuffed toys on a shelf, pale moonlight, eerie stillness, nobody present.

name: interrogation
prompt: A police interrogation room, bare metal table, two chairs, a cone-shaped lamp hanging low, cold harsh light, an empty wheelchair standing in the corner, nobody present.

name: route_night
prompt: Aerial view of an empty two-lane highway crossing a dark rural landscape at night, long red and white light trails, fog over fields.

name: records

name: clinical

name: pinboard

name: storm

name: house_closed

name: charity

name: fog

name: spotlight

name: dress_hanger

name: doll

name: hands

name: glass_box

name: cage

name: night_street

name: night_screen

name: corridor

name: interrogation_gypsy
prompt: A police interrogation room with a bare metal table and cone lamp. A slender young woman stands beside the table seen from behind, wearing a knitted beanie, her face hidden, no facial features visible. An empty wheelchair in the corner. Cold harsh light.

name: bedroom_door_gypsy

name: spotlight_deedee

name: glass_box_gypsy

name: crowd_away

name: two_shadows
prompt: Two dark human silhouettes, a young man in a hoodie and a slender young woman, stand apart facing each other in a dark room; their long shadows on the wall merge into a single shape. Faces hidden, cold blue screen light, unsettling.
